### Employment for People With Disabilities Essay

#### Introduction
Employment is one of the most basic human rights. It provides a person with purpose, respect, independence, income, social interaction, and many other personal and professional benefits. However, people with disabilities have historically faced more difficulty than others in being employed. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), 15% of the world’s population live with some kind of disability. Despite this high percentage, people with disabilities tend to face employment discrimination. In the United States, the Civil Rights Act of 1964 was amended with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) in 1990 to make employment for people with disabilities fair and reasonable.

#### What Is Reasonable Accommodation?
“Reasonable accommodation” means conditions created for a person with a disability for the professional performance of their qualified work. Such accommodation should create equality and not cause additional inconvenience. The concept of reasonable accommodation is part of the ADA.

#### Reasonable Accommodation in the US
In the American context, according to the ADA, it is illegal for any employer to discriminate on the basis of disability. If an employer is not reasonable in accommodating the needs of the person with the disability, he or she will be guilty of employment discrimination. The ADA requires that all reasonable accommodations must be made unless it would cause extreme hardship to the company, which would be a burden on its business. 

An employee is required to inform his or her employer that he or she has a disability and what sort of assistance is required to do the job. An employer cannot refuse the request without any valid reason. The only condition that is accepted is if making the reasonable accommodation would cause extreme hardship to the business. The term “extreme hardship” usually means that if making the accommodation does not fit within the employer's budget or it would not be possible to hire another person to do the job.

### Analytic Philosophy: The Views by Wittgenstein and Ayer

Philosophy is an attempt of human beings to logically explain the processes that take place in the world. There are numerous branches of philosophy including philosophy of nature, history, mind, language, society, and religion. Among these branches, one of the most prominent and influential branches of Western Philosophy is analytic philosophy. Analytic philosophy originated in the 19th century in the UK and the USA and was characterized by a method of analysis to solve philosophical problems. The most famous representatives of analytic philosophy were Bertrand Russell and Ludwig Wittgenstein, who later turned to be one of the main representatives of the later tradition. This paper will analyze the views of the British philosopher Ludwig Wittgenstein and the American philosopher A.J. Ayer concerning analytic philosophy. It will provide a brief overview of the analytical philosophy and compare its views with those of Ayer.

Analytic philosophy began as a reaction against the philosophy of idealism which was dominant in Germany in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. Idealists believed that there is only a rational universe which can be known through the use of logic. They believed that we cannot know what the world outside our brains is like. Analytic philosophers disagreed with this view. Analytic philosophers tried to find out how the world really works and they did so by looking for a way to reduce the sentences into simple components that could be understood more easily. Wittgenstein and Ayer were among the first analytic philosophers, but their views on the nature of philosophy were different from each other.

Ludwig Wittgenstein is one of the most important philosophers of the 20th century. He is considered as the father of analytic philosophy. His work has influenced many other philosophers of that time, like Ayer, in various ways. He was born in 1889 and died in 1951.

Earnings describe the benefits of an organization, which is the content of the earnings report and an important summary of the financial report. Earnings are the fundamental element in a financial report because they represent the net income generated over a certain period. The earnings quality refers to the reliability and consistency of the earnings. Earnings management, on the other hand, refers to the intentional or unintentional manipulation of earnings for some reasons such as for manipulation of financial statements, to attract investors or lenders, or to meet expectations of analysts. These terms are of particular interest in the field of business, finance and accounting. This research paper will examine the relationship between earnings management and earnings quality.

Earnings Management

There are different kinds of earnings management techniques and most of them are intended for making the company appear better in the eyes of stakeholders. For example, earnings management can be done through the understatement of expenses. This will have the effect of increasing the income for the company, but at the same time, it will reduce the earnings quality. On the other hand, earnings management can also be done through the understatement of taxes. This will also increase the income, and at the same time, it will reduce the earnings quality (Shah, & Tewari, 2009).

**Importance of Conserving Electricity**

It is impossible to imagine the modern world without electricity because it enables the work of all gadgets and household appliances that make everyday life easy and convenient. Furthermore, business, medical, production, and all the other important sectors in our economy need electricity to operate. With the increasing consumption of electricity, the demand for electricity from various companies has been on a constant rise. This paper explains why conserving electricity is important in today's world.

Firstly, conserving energy leads to the prevention of global warming. When we conserve the amount of energy that we use, we reduce the carbon footprint that we leave for future generations. Energy is consumed through the production of electricity which produces gases known as greenhouse gases which cause the earth’s temperature to increase leading to global warming. As a result, we can reduce the emission of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere by using less electricity. This will help us to minimize global warming.

Secondly, conserving electricity saves people money. The price of buying power from the electric company continues to be on the rise every month, so saving power means that you have more money left over for other things. Saving electricity can also help you pay fewer bills each month, as you will not be consuming large amounts of electricity.

Thirdly, conserving electricity helps to reduce the strain on the power stations that generate electricity. If all the consumers in the country would reduce the amount of electricity they consume, then this would mean that there would be less demand for electricity. **Importance of Conserving Electricity**

It is impossible to imagine the modern world without electricity because it enables the work of all gadgets and household appliances that make everyday life easy and convenient. Furthermore, business, medical, production, and all the other important sectors in our economy need electricity to operate. With the increasing consumption of electricity, the demand for electricity from various companies has been on a constant rise. This paper explains why conserving electricity is important in today's world.

Firstly, conserving energy leads to the prevention of global warming. When we conserve the amount of energy that we use, we reduce the carbon footprint that we leave for future generations. Energy is consumed through the production of electricity which produces gases known as greenhouse gases which cause the earth’s temperature to increase leading to global warming. As a result, we can reduce the emission of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere by using less electricity. This will help us to minimize global warming.

Secondly, conserving electricity saves people money. The price of buying power from the electric company continues to be on the rise every month, so saving power means that you have more money left over for other things. Saving electricity can also help you pay fewer bills each month, as you will not be consuming large amounts of electricity.

Thirdly, conserving electricity helps to reduce the strain on the power stations that generate electricity. If all the consumers in the country would reduce the amount of electricity they consume, then this would mean that there would be less demand for electricity. This will lower the stress of the power stations and will give them the chance to repair or maintain their equipment and machinery before the equipment breaks down.

Fourthly, conserving electricity helps to preserve the environment. Power stations produce energy by burning coal, oil, and natural gas. However, when these things burn, they produce a lot of poisonous gases. When we conserve electricity, we save a lot of fuel which means that we do not have to use so much of these toxic items.
